data.title: Gu Xiong
data.synopsis:
In the near future, the S organization has mastered genetic engineering technology, creating super soldiers to alter the world order. One of the first genetically modified soldiers, "Xunlang," suffers an accident during an experiment, regaining deleted memories of his former name, "Qianwu." He escapes the S organization to retrieve his lost memories. While evading the organization's pursuit, Qianwu gradually recalls his past and, through a series of adventures including searching for his family, ultimately rediscovers his true self and achieves self-redemption…

(Source: Tencent, translated)

Title and story subject to change

(Source: Kickstarter)

Ren Arisugawa Is Actually a Girl

data.title: Arisugawa Ren tte Honto wa Onna Nanda yo ne.
data.title_english: Ren Arisugawa Is Actually a Girl
data.title_japanese: 有栖川煉ってホントは女なんだよね。
data.synopsis:
A secret that could shake the entire entertainment industry— This sweet and innocent rom-com is a long-time bestseller! Kyouhei's one and only claim to fame? Being cousins with Ren Arisugawa, an ultra-popular male idol. The two haven’t seen each other since they were kids, but out of the blue, Ren suddenly shows up to crash at Kyouhei’s rundown apartment. But when Kyouhei playfully tries to sneak a peek while Ren’s changing, he makes a shocking discovery! Ren is actually a girl in disguise! Now holding a scandalous secret that could rock the showbiz world, Kyohei finds himself forced into becoming Ren’s personal assistant to keep up the act…! Caught in a world of secrets and scandals, can the two keep their forbidden relationship under wraps in the wild world of showbiz?

(Source: Official Site)
data.background: The anime aired in two versions: an all-ages broadcast version, and an uncut 18+ version streamed on ComicFesta Anime Zone. This entry reflects an uncut 18+ version of the anime. Episode 1 received an advanced distribution on AnimeFesta on December 12th, 2025. The standard TV version of the anime debuted on January 4, 2026 at 1:00 a.m. on Tokyo MX.

data.title: Toritsukare Otoko
data.synopsis:
Giuseppe is a young man who tends to get completely absorbed in whatever catches his interest. Because of this, the townspeople call him "Toristukare Otoko." One day, he falls in love at first sight with a girl named Pechka, who sells balloons but seems to carry a quiet sadness. Wanting to help her, Giuseppe and his mouse companion, Cielo, start using the skills he's picked up over the years to secretly solve the problems weighing on her heart.

(Source: MAL News)

data.title: Guangyin Zhi Wai
data.synopsis:
The world was a temporary dwelling for all beings, and time flowed like passing travelers. Where the shattered sky opened its eerie eye, life perished and zones became forbidden. In the apocalypse, consequences followed, and life arose from death.

(Source: Youku)
data.background: Adaptation of Ergen's (耳根) web novel of the same title.

data.title: Wadachi wo Koete Yuke
data.synopsis:
In the shadow of a ruinous war, three young women are serving as soldiers in a barren, snow-swept landscape. Their task is to scour the frozen wastes for stragglers of the Iron Army, eerie, formerly human flesh-weapons. Gros and especially the inexperienced Leichte admire Esus, stronger and wiser than they. Esus has her weaknesses, though, and unhealed wounds in her heart. Somewhere out there in the vast, deadly sea of snow lie answers—to Esus' pain, and to the awful secret of this war.

(Source: Official Site)

data.title: Xian Di Guilai
data.synopsis:
The young warrior Yun Qingyan disappeared from the world three years ago, but he was actually drawn into the immortal world for three thousand years! With his extraordinary talent, he became the Yun Emperor, one of the ten great immortal emperors. However, because he was tired of the intrigues in the immortal world and missed his family, he decided to return to the mortal world at all costs. 

Upon return to the mortal world, his parents and sister strangely disappeared, and due to an incident whilst traveling from the immortal world to the mortal world, he lost his magic weapon and his cultivation became almost zero. Major forces took this opportunity to hunt him down. The immortal emperor became the target of public criticism, and his family was in danger! Yun Qingyan relied on his extraordinary immortal emperor talent to refine pills and array formations, study and practice, and overwhelm his enemies. He embarks on an adventure to revive his family, find his relatives, and rectify the mortal world. 

(Source: Bilibili, translated)

data.title: Jian Lai 2nd Season
data.synopsis:
After the Li Zhu Grotto-Heaven collapses, Chen Ping’an takes on a great responsibility to escort Li Baoping and the others to Great Sui to study. Their journey is extremely dangerous, with enemies and supernatural threats along the way, but they receive help from the mysterious swordsman A Liang and other powerful figures. Traveling far and fighting countless battles, the young man grows stronger while learning the weight of responsibility.

(Source: WeTV)

data.title: Xuan Jie Zhi Men
data.synopsis:
In a world where warriors are respected, Shi Mu's fate seems destined to be different. As the adopted son of an aristocratic family, he is forced to embark on the road of a warrior to find the truth and redeem himself. From the four halls of Fengcheng to the struggle between sects, interests are entangled, and powerful enemies lurk. Every challenge makes Shi Mu more determined. In the end, Shi Mu realizes the power of his bloodline, which not only changes his own destiny, but also affects the future of many people.

(Source: Bilibili, translated)
data.background: Adaptation of Wang Yu's (忘语) web novel of the same title.

data.title: Aoshi Dan Shen
data.synopsis:
Born with a disability, and taking a desperate gamble, Shen Xiang ventures into perilous lands to find medicine to open his spiritual meridians. He unexpectedly saves two injured goddesses, one divine and one demonic, awakening his own divine meridians. Protecting his father and family, he becomes a legendary alchemist!

(Source: iQIYI, translated)

data.title: Sanxian Lun Hui
data.synopsis:
Where the Yellow, Yangtze, and Lancang Rivers begin as one, dwell the three "Water Ghost" clans, the Ding, Jiang, and Yi, along their banks. What are Water Ghosts? Beings who move through water as they please, masters of geomancy and treasure hunting. Yi Sa, the last of her line, runs an "underwater bank" along the Lancang. During a perilous "Golden Soup" dive, she rescues Zong Hang. Seeking truth and a cure for her own fate, Yi Sa trains him as a Water Ghost. Together with Ding Yu Die of the Ding clan, the trio descends into the primordial "Ancestral Golden Soup."

(Source: WeTV)
data.background: Adaptation of Wei Yu's (尾鱼) web novel, Sanxian Lunhui (三线轮回).

data.title: Oshi ga Buka ni Narimashita
data.title_japanese: 推しが部下になりました
data.synopsis:
Sayaka Tsuneda, age 29, works at an advertising agency when one day a suit-wearing angel descends before her very own eyes?! The idol that gave her life worth meaning is now her co-worker and she's in charge of his training... Is this a dream?! Sayaka struggles to handle her own feelings as the two of them grow closer and closer. How will this awkward fan girl's love story end?!

(Source: MangaPlaza)
